frozen_fixture_policy: All 17 original hashes must validate. Inputs, prompts, questions and evaluator references remain unchanged. Gold is never parsed by the generator.
backend: official llama.cpp b10852 (050dde50c), Apple Metal MTL0, localhost chat completions API
context_reason: A common context with room for all supplied passages and output, while reserving memory for OS/runtime on 48 GiB. Every actual rendered prompt is tokenized before inference; no source truncation.
reasoning: off, through server and enable_thinking=false chat template kwargs
capacity_exclusion: Falcon 180B's 2048-token supported context cannot contain the complete frozen passages plus output. Do not truncate source and call it the same accuracy battery.
grading: Codex-assisted source adjudication, not independent human grading. Keep correct/partial/contradiction/unsupported/qualification-loss/ambiguous/no-answer categories, separate citation support and the four source-absent cases. Summaries and syntheses require claim and coverage ledgers. No keyword score as factual accuracy.
comparison_limit: A configuration comparison on the same Mac. Model hashes, context, backend and MTP differ from the original Evo profiles; do not silently pool results. Throughput and smoke tests are separate from accuracy.
